tools.name: status
tools.description: Engine status: version, Banister time constants, optimal TSB window, demo-data markers.

tools.name: athlete.profile
tools.description: Banister CTL (fitness), ATL (fatigue) and TSB (form) for an athlete, folded over the demo TRIMP history. history_source=demo.

tools.name: athlete.predict
tools.description: Predict finish time and recommended pace for a target distance from current chronic fitness.

tools.name: gait.analyze
tools.description: IMU gait kinematics fixture: cadence, vertical oscillation, ground contact time, leg spring stiffness, asymmetry. source=demo (no sensor attached).

tools.name: soccer.leagues
tools.description: List the five demo European soccer leagues (Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1). source=demo.

tools.name: soccer.standings
tools.description: Demo league table (played/won/drawn/lost, goals, points, form). source=demo.

tools.name: soccer.fixtures
tools.description: Demo upcoming fixtures for a league with kickoff labels and venues. source=demo.

tools.name: soccer.predict
tools.description: Predict a match from demo ratings (win/draw/away %, expected goals, pick). source=demo.

tools.name: trainer.catalog
tools.description: Exercise library filtered by location (gym sees gym+both, home sees home+both). source=demo.

tools.name: trainer.plan
tools.description: Build a weekly gym/home plan (2-5 days) for a goal and level. General fitness info, not medical advice. source=demo.

tools.name: trainer.session
tools.description: Build one coached workout (warmup, main, cooldown, TRIMP estimate, cues). General fitness info, not medical advice. source=demo.
